design: Closed thick-walled pressure vessel, three seated pressure bands, four tapered red haunches and steel back braces, real closed hinged hatch, separate supported injector/product transfer, rear thermal cabinet and guarded fan, clear front maintenance corridor
pending: Actual source/export mechanical and surface readback

surface_assignments.object: TP Metallization Crucible V01 | thick wall central pressure vessel
surface_assignments.plan: Circumferential U / actual vessel Z. Dirt follows three pressure-band seats, lower plinth, true hatch collar and two drilled nozzles. Restrained thermal discoloration follows the two seated contact bands; no uniform decorative striping.

surface_assignments.object: TP Metallization Crucible V01 | closed graded pressure crown
surface_assignments.plan: Azimuth U / actual graded crown Z. Concentric lathe marks follow pressure-crown rings; restrained dirt only at the lower seated rim and service-hatch collar, replacing broad generic donor clouds.

surface_assignments.object: TP Metallization Crucible V01 | tapered pressure haunch 0
surface_assignments.plan: Four instances of the same tapered casting. Face UV follows the actual inclined haunch width and height; exposed longitudinal edges wear through red enamel, dirt sits at the grounded shoe and upper collar seat. Fine cast grain, no random black scratch stamp.

surface_assignments.object: TP Metallization Crucible V01 | tapered pressure haunch 1
surface_assignments.plan: Four instances of the same tapered casting. Face UV follows the actual inclined haunch width and height; exposed longitudinal edges wear through red enamel, dirt sits at the grounded shoe and upper collar seat. Fine cast grain, no random black scratch stamp.
